p: shut up: That none could go in.
because of the children of Israel: for fear of the Israelites.
rams' horns: That the conquest might not be assigned to man's power, but to the mercy of God, which with most weak things can overcome that which seems most strong.
Pass on: This is chiefly meant by the Reubenites, Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
rereward came after the ark: Meaning, the gathering host, in which was the standard of the tribe of Dan, Nu 10:25.
rereward came after the ark of: The tribe of Dan was so called, because it marched last and gathered up whatever was left of others.
seven times: Beside every day once for the space of six days.
accursed: That is appointed wholly to be destroyed.
consecrated unto the LORD: And therefore cannot be put to any private use, but must be first molten, and then serve for the Tabernacle.
without the camp of Israel: For it was not lawful for strangers to dwell among the Israelites, till they were purged.
house of the LORD: Meaning, the tabernacle.
dwelleth in Israel even unto this: For she was married to Salmon prince of the tribe of Judah, Mt 1:5.
he shall lay the foundation thereof: He will build it to the destruction of all his stock, which was fulfilled in Hiel of Beth-el, 1Ki 16:34.
